title: Vanessa found the teller tape for the documentary
summary: Luigi tells of Vanessa found the teller tape for the documentary, about 1989 at Las Vegas, Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: We wouldn't have found the teller tape if it wasn't for Vanessa.

plain: A man named Luigi, who spent time with Bob Lazar, a man at the center of UFO stories from Las Vegas in 1989, talks about the making of a documentary. He says a recording known as the teller tape would never have been found without a woman named Vanessa, who tracked it down.
